svg.title: The Brevis console, a workflow
svg.desc: One workflow's page: its cron and tags, a form to run it with parameters, a 96.1 per cent success rate over 176 runs, the DAG with each step's state, a calendar of a year of runs where each square is a day coloured by that day's worst outcome, and the workflow's own run history.
svg.text: One square per day — the colour is the day's worst outcome, not how much ran.
